Meet Marci Metzger

A familiar face.
A trusted guide.

Pahrump resident · Managing broker

My real estate career began in Washington, where I worked as a REALTOR and licensed broker. I’ve helped buyers and sellers through different markets since 1995. Today, Mountain Falls is home, and Southern Nevada is where I put that experience to work.

“I love that small-town feeling that our community offers.”

— Marci, in her own words

Whether you’re looking at a Mountain Falls home or a property with more acreage, let’s start with how you want to live—and work from there.

Let’s talk about your next move

Real estate, made personal

Good decisions start with local knowledge.

A Pahrump home is more than its asking price. We’ll look at the practical details that make a property work for you.

01 / Your home, thoughtfully presented

Make the first impression count.

From the kitchen to the outdoor space, a clear presentation helps buyers understand a home. Let’s talk through what to prepare before your Pahrump property goes on the market.

02 / A considered selling plan

More than a listing. A plan.

Pricing, presentation, and the next move should work together. We’ll discuss your property, your timeline, and how to reach buyers looking in Pahrump.

03 / A guide at your side

Buy with a clearer picture.

Whether you’re considering Mountain Falls or a home with room for horses, bring your questions. We’ll discuss the property, the process, and the specialists you may need along the way.
